title: AMD 2022 10-K — Consolidated Statements of Cash Flows (Year Ended December 31, 2022)
key_points: FY2022 (year ended December 31, 2022) net cash provided by operating activities was $3,565 million (FY2021: $3,521 million; FY2020: $1,071 million).
FY2022 net cash provided by (used in) investing activities was +$1,999 million (FY2021: -$686 million; FY2020: -$952 million).
FY2022 net cash (used in) provided by financing activities was -$3,264 million (FY2021: -$1,895 million; FY2020: +$6 million).
FY2022 net increase in cash and cash equivalents was $2,300 million; cash and cash equivalents at end of year was $4,835 million.

Investing activities line items for FY2022 include: purchases of property and equipment $(450) million, purchases of short-term investments $(2,667) million, proceeds from maturity of short-term investments $4,310 million, cash received from acquisition of Xilinx $2,366 million, acquisition of Pensando net of cash acquired $(1,544) million.

Financing activities line items for FY2022 include: proceeds from debt net of issuance costs $991 million, repayment of debt $(312) million, proceeds from sales of common stock through employee equity plans $167 million, repurchases of common stock $(3,702) million, common stock repurchases for tax withholding on employee equity plans $(406) million.
Operating activities for FY2022 start from net income of $1,320 million, with depreciation and amortization of $4,174 million and deferred income taxes of $(1,505) million among the adjustments.

title: AMD 2022 10-K — MD&A narrative discussion of Operating, Investing and Financing Activities
key_points: Operating: net cash provided by operating activities was $3.6 billion in 2022, primarily due to net income of $1.3 billion, adjusted for non-cash adjustments of $4.1 billion and net cash outflows of $1.8 billion from changes in operating assets and liabilities.

Operating asset/liability drivers in 2022: $1.4 billion increase in inventories, $1.1 billion increase in accounts receivable, $1.2 billion increase in prepaid expenses and other assets, offset by $931 million increase in accounts payable and $546 million increase in accrued liabilities and other.

Investing: net cash provided by investing activities was $2 billion in 2022, primarily from $4.3 billion of maturities of short-term investments and $2.4 billion of cash acquired in the Xilinx acquisition, partially offset by $2.7 billion of purchases of short-term investments, $1.5 billion used for the Pensando acquisition and $450 million of property and equipment purchases.

Financing: net cash used in financing activities was $3.3 billion in 2022, primarily common stock repurchases of $3.7 billion under the Repurchase Program, $406 million of tax-withholding repurchases and $312 million of debt repayment, partially offset by $991 million of debt issuance proceeds and $167 million from employee equity plans.
FY2021 comparatives in the same narrative: operating $3.5 billion provided, investing $686 million used, financing $1.9 billion used.
